title: Easy morning in and around Barcelona
text: Picked up at pier and showed us the wonderful spots to visit in Barcelona the next time we have more time. Wonderful Driver, Giordi and Tour Guide, Maria. Was a great way to spend the morning rather than being on a giant bus. Comfortable ride, water and given choices to tailor it to what we preferred.
author: Amanda_C

title: Fantastic!
text: Maria was perfect! She went at our own pace, listened to what our interests were, and steered us to the best places. We couldn’t have asked for a better tour of Barcelona!
author: Beth_L

title: Maria was a great guide. ...
text: Maria was a great guide.  The day we took our tour with her was the same day the Pope visited Barcelona so many of the streets were closed.   She managed to still find a way to show us around the city.
author: Jim_U

title: Best use of a short amount of time. We learned so much about the masters of the architecture world.
text: Pedro was an amazing guide and shared his passion and knowledge of the architecture that Barcelona is built around. The masters that influenced the world are around every corner and you will miss them walking on your own. So much history in 4 hours. Fully captivated.
author: Dee P

title: An absolute heartfelt recommendation ❤️
text:
Our city trip with Pedro was an extraordinarily brilliant experience! From the very first minute, he managed to captivate us with his open, warm personality and incredible knowledge.

The tour was not only super interesting but also full of exciting stories, hidden places, and special moments that we would have never discovered without Pedro. You can immediately tell how much he loves his work – and that is exactly what makes the experience so unique and unforgettable.

author: Melanie_K

title: Great tour with Maria!
text: We had a private tour with Maria.  All I can say is I wish I could give more stars!!  She was wonderful!  We saw things I never expected to see.  She is so knowledgeable, patient and fun!  The pace for us was perfect!  We toured the old Towne.  Maria took us to Sagrada Familia which was the highlight of the tour.  But I have to say the churros and chocolate were divine!!  I recommend this company and definitely Maria if she is available!!  Best day!!
author: Terry C

title: Wonderful City with a wonderful Guide
text: We had a wonderful  4 hour sightseeing tour in Barcelona, because of our competent guide and her driver. Mari Carmen not only showed us the Must Sees of Barcelona, but also gave us a lot of information of the history, culture and the famous artists  and architects of the City. We recommend  her tour very much. You will have a pleasant time with a very friendly Guide, who is flexible and willing to make the Tour according to your wishes.
author: Sherpa54344911876

title: Great tour of Barcelona
text:
My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our private tour with Mari. She was extremely knowledgeable and also very personable 
She made allowances for our physical needs and our interests. I would definitely recommend this tour
author: shonef2

title: 5 Canadians
text:
Our guide Maria was absolutely awesome and amazing! She was very knowledgeable and friendly and we had a very enjoyable and informative tour.
We recommend her 110%.
Driver Jordi was very, very good as well.
author: Naneen_S

title: Amazing Tour
text:
Mari is the best guide, she is so knowledgeable & very passionate about Barcelona. The tour was customisable to our likes. Our driver Saint George had a beautifully clean & comfy Mercedes van with bottled water. We chose to go into the Sagrada Familia and it was the best decision ever we, loved it. The exquisite architectural design using light & stained glass is breathtaking. The unusual building designs make Barcelona strand out from other cities.  There was so much more to see however, we had  time restraints so next time we will book an entire day.
